summary_rationale: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Ltd passes the price-blind business-quality screen as an IP-led, engineering-differentiated Tier-1 electronics platform (COMPOUNDER_PASS) with PASS_WITH_WATCH operational KPIs. Founded out of IIT Bombay in 2007, SEDEMAC has built genuine technological moats in patented sensorless Integrated Starter Generator (ISG) and Electronic Fuel Injection (EFI) ECUs (~35% domestic 2W/3W ISG volume share; >5M cumulative scooter controllers by Oct 2026; 1.45M ECUs in Q2 FY27, +37.5% YoY; European 2W/3W OEM win for H1 FY28) alongside a ~75% domestic market share in Indian genset AMF controllers. Revenue compounded at 34.5% over five years to ₹1,058 Cr in FY26 (₹1,265 Cr TTM) with ROCE reaching 35.3%, ROE 26.9%, and an India Ratings upgrade to IND A/Stable. However, five structural and forensic watch items require active monitoring: (1) extreme customer concentration with TVS Motor (~75–81% of revenue) and Mobility rising to 91.1% of H1 FY27 sales after Industrial gensets contracted -21.8% YoY to ₹63.02 Cr; (2) H1 FY27 Operating Cash Flow turning negative (-₹20.38 Cr vs +₹120.73 Cr YoY) as receivables (₹212.16 Cr) and inventory (₹287.81 Cr) surged, lifting financial borrowings from ₹50.63 Cr to ₹245.64 Cr (short-term debt 7.4x to ₹153.19 Cr) plus ₹106.47 Cr of Ind AS 116 lease liabilities following a 100% OFS IPO; (3) gross-margin sensitivity to global PCB and semiconductor inflation (H1 FY27 OPM at 19.2% vs 21.4% YoY); (4) contested domestic 2W/3W EV MCU competition from Lucas-TVS, Sterling Tools, Minda Corp, and OEM in-house units; and (5) post-lock-up PE block-deal overhang and ~2.2% ESOP 2025 dilution.
